title: Timelines for Implementation of Regulatory Changes by Stock Brokers
content:
FICTIONAL DEMO CIRCULAR — NOT AN ACTUAL SEBI PUBLICATION.

To,
All Stock Brokers through Recognised Stock Exchanges.

Sub: Timelines for Implementation of Regulatory Changes by Stock Brokers

1. It has been observed during inspections that some stock brokers do not have a defined timeline within which internal policies are updated after a regulatory publication.

2. Accordingly, it is clarified that:
2.1. Every stock broker shall assess the applicability of each SEBI or exchange publication and record the assessment within 7 working days of publication.
2.2. Internal policies and procedures affected by a publication shall be reviewed and, where required, amended within 30 calendar days of the publication date, or by the effective date stated in the publication, whichever is earlier.
2.3. A record of each such review, citing the regulatory provision and the affected internal document, shall be maintained and made available to the stock exchange on request.

3. This circular is effective immediately and applies to all stock brokers.

4. Issued for demonstration purposes only.
